about_the_game:
Fyte is a Twitch-Integrated battler built for streamers and viewers to battle it out by simply typing !play in chat. Up to 250 viewers spawn into a chaotic bot-controlled battlefield to fight it out across multiple maps and game modes.

  • Last Viewer Standing: It's every viewer for themselves. Many shall enter, but only one will survive.

  • Deathmatch: Which viewer has what it takes to be the first to reach the winning score?

  • Team Deathmatch: Back to basics. Red vs Blue for all the marbles.

  • King of the Hill: Red vs Blue. Teams fight for control of the hill in this classic team-based game mode.

  • Boost Engagement: Viewers can !play, !attack <username>, and !vote for maps directly from chat or using the Fyte Twitch Extension

  • Unleash Bit Powered Events: The Fyte Twitch Extension allows streamers to monetize gameplay with ease with viewer interactions. Air Strikes, Alien Abductions, Revives, and more triggered using Twitch Bits. Streamers can set their own pricing, cooldowns, and activate/deactivate events as they please.

  • Leaderboards: Fyte for bragging rights with Global and Per-Channel Leaderboards. Streamers can earn recognition as Top Fyte Streamers, while viewers can !play their way to the top in their favorite Twitch channel or the world! In-game leaderboards feature both channel and global results, while the Fyte Leaderboard Extension highlights each channel’s top Fyters.

  • Stand Out: Customize your avatar your way with hats, faces, attachments, victory dances, and weapon colors. Everything you need to be unique and stand out as a Fyter on the battlefield.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable internet recommended for best Twitch interaction experience
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable internet recommended for best Twitch interaction experience
